title: Feature-Aware (Hyper)graph Generation via Next-Scale Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2506.01467v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graph generative models perform well on small-scale structured data but struggle to scale to large, complex structures. Hierarchical approaches improve scalability but often ignore node and edge features, which are critical in real-world applications. In this paper, we propose FAHNES (feature-aware (hyper)graph generation via next-scale prediction), a hierarchical framework that jointly generates topology and features for graphs and hypergraphs. FAHNES progressively constructs the final sample through localized expansion and refinement, guided by a novel node budget controlling granularity and ensuring cross-scale consistency. Experiments on synthetic, 3D mesh, and graph point cloud datasets demonstrate competitive or state-of-the-art performance while uniquely scaling to large-scale graphs and hypergraphs with features. Our code is open source.

translated_title: 基于下一尺度预测的特征感知（超）图生成
translated_abstract: 图生成模型在小规模结构化数据上表现良好，但在扩展到大规模复杂结构时面临挑战。分层方法提高了可扩展性，但往往忽略了对实际应用至关重要的节点和边特征。在本文中，我们提出了FAHNES（通过下一尺度预测进行特征感知的（超）图生成），这是一个联合生成图和超图的拓扑与特征的层次化框架。FAHNES通过局部扩展和细化逐步构建最终样本，并由一种新颖的节点预算指导，该预算控制粒度并确保跨尺度一致性。在合成数据集、3D网格和图点云数据集上的实验表明，该方法达到了竞争性或最先进的性能，同时独特地扩展到带有特征的大规模图和超图。我们的代码已开源。
tldr: 本文提出FAHNES框架，通过下一尺度预测和节点预算控制，首次实现了同时生成大规模图和超图拓扑及特征的高效层次化方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FAHNES, a hierarchical framework that jointly generates topology and features for large-scale graphs and hypergraphs via next-scale prediction with a novel node budget.
